description: Fetches any public http(s) page and returns clean Markdown: headings (#), paragraphs, lists, links with absolute URLs, bold/italic, and code blocks. Scripts, styles and nav/footer are removed. Output is capped at the first 50,000 characters, with a truncated flag. Blocks localhost and private addresses. Returns JSON with url, status, title, chars, truncated and markdown. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.02 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/page-to-markdown.
name: page-to-markdown
